Curator Backtest — compounder preview (CBT-preview)

2023-07-24 to 2026-07-22

The watchlist-curator agent was called biweekly over the 2023-07-24 to 2026-07-22 window. At each rebalance it read a date-clean news pool for the preceding biweekly window (built upstream from GDELT GKG + Wayback, look-ahead-reduced; browse them in the pool browser) and proposed adds and removes against the active watchlist; the optimizer then ran mean-variance on the revised watchlist. Each rebalance is marked by an orange square on the curator curve in chart 2 — hover over one to see that rebalance's adds, removes, and the curator's rationale. The buy-and-hold curve below is the value of the initial portfolio (which never gets rebalanced or optimized) over time. The buy-and-hold portfolio has equal amounts of [AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN] and is held without any rebalancing across the window. Throughout the charts below: general_markets = defensive equity ETFs (broad-market / dividend / utilities / staples); cashlike = bonds + cash-equivalents + precious metals (e.g., AGG, BIL, IAU).

Rationale: Added NXE (nuclear/uranium) as the only change this biweekly window. The Niger coup ( July 26-29 ) created a clear geopolitical catalyst for uranium supply security that wasn't present two weeks prior — a genuine new-catalyst test. Profile already has SMR (SMR nuclear buildout) and RKLB (rockets/space); adding uranium exposure diversifies within the nuclear wave bucket at a different point in the value chain (fuel supply vs. reactor construction). All other wave buckets showed no investable US-listed candidates with fresh catalysts: space news was dominated by private SpaceX and international government launches; robotics showed only thinly-traded RWLK board changes and foreign/private automation vendors; quantum computing had no US-listed pure-plays with recent milestones (D-Wave private, atom computing private, silicon quantum computing Australian); geo_tankers saw Ukraine attacks on Russian tankers but no new listed-tanker catalyst beyond existing energy exposure; geo_defense had primes LMT/NOC already well-covered in broad market; geo_drones showed Anduril (private) and foreign munitions; demographics had only senior-living operator distress (Attane closure). AI wave already well-represented via AAPL/AMZN/GOOGL/LLY. Filtered ~90% of pool as noise: war/weather events, private companies, foreign/OTC listings, keyword false-matches (horse racing 'Geaux Rocket Ride', oil tanker fires/accidents unrelated to energy shipping, 'Vision 2030' megaproject keyword collisions unrelated to space).
